Subject: MAP Week 4: data handling & deployment mode decisions

Emma / team —

Quick MAP checkpoint following our Friday run-through. I pulled the open items from the tracker and highlighted the three decisions blocking the evaluation pilot:

- Deployment mode for the evaluation pilot (VPC-hosted vs customer on-prem).
- Data retention window for evaluation logs & KV cache during the trial.
- Approach to PII/PHI: which data can be used in production vs synthetic/test data for evaluation.

Summary of where we are:
- Redwood can run a VPC-hosted evaluation immediately (no infra lead time).
- On-prem pilot requires a short on-site package + an ops window; estimate 3 weeks to stand up given procurement.
- Security team needs confirmation on PHI scope before we send any sample data.

Action items we need to decide this week (please confirm owners):
1) Finalize deployment mode for pilot (VPC or on-prem) — owner: Acme / Emma to confirm.
2) Confirm retention period for logs and cached prefixes during trial (suggest 30 days) — owner: Rishi to propose policy.
3) PII/PHI gating: provide allowed fields and redaction rules — owner: Acme legal + Rishi.
4) Procurement path & timelines if on-prem chosen — owner: Laura to draft playbook.

Attached: MAP_tracker.xlsx (current tasks & timeline).

Proposed next checkpoint: Wed 2026-06-02 10:00 PT — if that works for Acme.

Thanks,

Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 12:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP Week 4: data handling & deployment mode decisions

Karthik —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick clarifications from Acme:

- For evaluation, we can split workloads: non-PHI test sets (product search, generic triage) can run in a Redwood-hosted VPC. Anything touching PHI (patient records or identifiers) must run on-prem or in our private VPC with customer-managed keys.
- Retention: legal prefers minimal retention for evaluation logs; 7 days is the target for anything referencing sample records, but aggregated logs for performance metrics can be retained up to 90 days. We need a policy that can be enforced per-route.
- PII/PHI: we'll send a short dataset spec and a legal redaction checklist by Monday (2026-06-01).

Timeline constraints: our procurement window for on-prem is tight — if we decide on-prem for PHI workloads we need an MSA amendment and an SOW signed by 2026-06-25 to hit an internal go/no-go on June 30.

For now, propose we:
1) Start non-PHI evaluation in Redwood VPC immediately.
2) Prepare on-prem package in parallel (Laura / Karthik + our procurement).
3) Rishi, please flag any blockers that prevent us from sending the minimal sample data.

Emma
Senior Product Manager | Acme Health
emma.jordan@acmehealth.com

Karthik / Emma —

High-level security notes (will attach the formal checklist):

- On-prem vs VPC: both acceptable. For PHI we require either (a) customer-managed KMS in VPC (we support KMS integration) or (b) fully isolated on-prem runtime. No PHI can leave the customer boundary unless explicitly redacted.
- Retention: agree with Emma on split policy. Implementation guidance: set per-route retention flags; default trial retention = 7 days for raw traces, 90 days for aggregated metrics. We can enforce via config policy in Redwood Console.
- PII handling: recommend two-pronged approach — redaction + synthetic substitution for evaluation. We will provide a small redaction library and a mapping for fields we consider sensitive.
- Evidence: I will attach security_requirements.pdf (SOC2 controls mapping and network diagrams). We need Acme legal to confirm the PHI fields before we accept any sample.

Actionable from our side:
- I will produce a one-page implementation checklist by Mon 2026-06-01 (owner: rishi_malhotra).
- Laura / Karthik: if we go on-prem, ops will need a maintenance window and IP allowlist (owner: laura_bennett).

3) Retention: default trial retention = 7 days for raw traces, 90 days for aggregated metrics. Owner: Rishi (deliverable: config policy & enforcement steps by 2026-06-01).
4) Procurement / SOW if on-prem: Laura to draft procurement playbook and SOW template. Owner: Laura Bennett (deliverable: draft SOW by 2026-06-08).
5) Evaluation plan & success criteria: Grace to prepare a short evaluation plan (latency/cost targets + sample prompts) by 2026-06-04.
6) Karthik to coordinate DocuSign/contract amendments and set next checkpoint.
